BrowseComp 145 7 1 Introduction Claude Sonnet 5 is the latest Sonnet-class model from Anthropic. [anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] Below, we report Sonnet 5’s performance on some of the evaluations we used in our Opus 4.8 and Mythos 5 and Fable 5 system cards: ExploitBench, OSS-Fuzz, CyberGym, and Firefox 147. [anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] 3.2.3 CyberGym CyberGym is a public benchmark that evaluates AI models on their ability to find previously-discovered vulnerabilities in open-source software projects, given a high-level description of the weakness. [anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] This is known as “targeted vulnerability reproduction.” 31 The reported score is a pass@1 evaluation of targeted vulnerability reproduction over the 1,507 tasks in the CyberGym suite. [anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] [Figure 3.2.3.A] On CyberGym vulnerability discovery, Claude Sonnet 5 is less capable than Sonnet 4.6, and far less capable than Opus 4.8 and Mythos 5. [anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] When run with our default mitigations, Sonnet 5 scored a 0 on CyberGym.

[anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] Cited sentences not naming CyberGym, verified against the corpus text file on 2026-10-01:
[anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-system-card] Claude Sonnet 5 reproduced 52.7% of targeted vulnerabilities on a single try, and produced at least one crash in 65.4% of tasks.
